name: ca-interactive
description: Six cellular-automata-family web background animations in one page, each with a concept card.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist/nca && cp index.html styles.css dist/ && cp -R src dist/src && cp nca/weights.json nca/target.png dist/nca/
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npx wrangler@latest deploy
